headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Impeached Following Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has been removed from office by the Senate following a banking crisis involving the collapse of Ueno Bank. Peña is currently under house arrest on suspicion of breach of trust.
why: Political instability and the collapse of a significant financial institution in a developing economy can lead to currency volatility and reduced investor confidence in the country's sovereign debt.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political upheaval and banking failures typically trigger capital flight and currency depreciation.
